order_revision.name: order_revision
order_revision.value: "orders"."provider_revision" IS NULL OR (typeof("orders"."provider_revision") = 'integer' AND "orders"."provider_revision" BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991)

order_status_quantity.name: order_status_quantity
order_status_quantity.value: ("orders"."status" IN ('submitting','unknown','accepted','rejected') AND "orders"."filled_quantity" = 0) OR ("orders"."status" = 'partially_filled' AND "orders"."filled_quantity" > 0 AND "orders"."filled_quantity" < "orders"."quantity") OR ("orders"."status" = 'filled' AND "orders"."filled_quantity" = "orders"."quantity") OR ("orders"."status" IN ('canceled','expired') AND "orders"."filled_quantity" < "orders"."quantity")

position_reserved.name: position_reserved
position_reserved.value: typeof("position_snapshots"."reserved_quantity") = 'integer' AND "position_snapshots"."reserved_quantity" BETWEEN -9007199254740991 AND 9007199254740991 AND "position_snapshots"."reserved_quantity" BETWEEN 0 AND "position_snapshots"."quantity"

practice_cash_conserved.name: practice_cash_conserved
practice_cash_conserved.value: typeof("practice_cash"."available_units")='integer' AND typeof("practice_cash"."reserved_units")='integer' AND typeof("practice_cash"."spent_units")='integer' AND "practice_cash"."available_units">=0 AND "practice_cash"."reserved_units">=0 AND "practice_cash"."spent_units">=0 AND "practice_cash"."available_units"+"practice_cash"."reserved_units"+"practice_cash"."spent_units"=40000000

practice_order_terms.name: practice_order_terms
practice_order_terms.value: "practice_orders"."outcome" IN ('yes','no') AND "practice_orders"."status" IN ('open','expired','voided') AND "practice_orders"."price_cents" BETWEEN 1 AND 99 AND "practice_orders"."quantity" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND "practice_orders"."principal_cents"="practice_orders"."price_cents"*"practice_orders"."quantity" AND "practice_orders"."fee_cents"=CAST(("practice_orders"."principal_cents"+200)/400 AS INTEGER) AND "practice_orders"."total_cents"="practice_orders"."principal_cents"+"practice_orders"."fee_cents"

practice_sell_terms.name: practice_sell_terms
practice_sell_terms.value: "practice_sell_orders"."quantity" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND "practice_sell_orders"."price_cents" BETWEEN 1 AND 99 AND "practice_sell_orders"."outcome" IN ('yes','no') AND "practice_sell_orders"."status" IN ('open','cancelled','expired','voided')

transfer_revision.name: transfer_revision
transfer_revision.value: "cash_transfers"."provider_revision" IS NULL OR (typeof("cash_transfers"."provider_revision") = 'integer' AND "cash_transfers"."provider_revision" BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991)
